name: @dreamteamer/google-workspace
description: Explicit-account Google Workspace access through a local MCP bridge, with read-only tool selection by default.

dreamteamer.title: Google Workspace
dreamteamer.description: Access an explicitly selected Google account through a local workspace-mcp process. The bridge defaults to a fixed read-only tool set, refuses calls without a stored account credential, and keeps credentials outside the workspace. Configure and authorize accounts separately on each computer before use.
